import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_EDGE = 1000007;
    static int[] vv = new int[MAX_EDGE];
    static int[] nxt = new int[MAX_EDGE];
    static int[] cap = new int[MAX_EDGE];
    static int[] h = new int[1000]; // enough for nodes (max N*N*2 + 2 ~ 400*2+2=802)
    static int e;
    static int s, t, T, n;
    static int xz, yz;
    static int[][] dir = {{0,1},{0,-1},{1,0},{-1,0}};
    static int cnt;
    static int[] id = new int[300][300]; // max 210
    static int[] q1 = new int[MAX_EDGE], q2 = new int[MAX_EDGE];
    static int h1, h2, t1, t2;
    static int[][] v1 = new int[210][210], v2 = new int[210][210];
    static int[] pre = new int[1000];
    static int[] vis = new int[1000];
    static char[][] s1 = new char[210][], s2 = new char[210][];

    static boolean inside(int x, int y) {
        return x >= 0 && y >= 0 && x < n && y < n && s1[x][y] >= '0' && s1[x][y] <= '9';
    }

    static void add(int u, int v, int c) {
        vv[e] = v; nxt[e] = h[u]; cap[e] = c; h[u] = e++;
        vv[e] = u; nxt[e] = h[v]; cap[e] = 0; h[v] = e++;
    }

    static void bfs(int x, int y) {
        if (s2[x][y] != 0) {
            add(id[x][y] + cnt, t, s2[x][y] - '0');
        }
        if (s1[x][y] == '0') return;
        add(s, id[x][y], s1[x][y] - '0');
        if (s2[x][y] != 0) {
            add(id[x][y], id[x][y] + cnt, 10);
        }

        int sx = x, sy = y;
        h1 = t1 = h2 = t2 = 0;
        q1[t1++] = x; q1[t1++] = y;
        q2[t2++] = xz; q2[t2++] = yz;

        int up1 = t1, up2 = t2;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(v1[i], -1);
            Arrays.fill(v2[i], -1);
        }
        v1[x][y] = v2[xz][yz] = 0;

        int x1, y1;
        while (h1 < t1) {
            while (h1 < up1) {
                x = q1[h1++]; y = q1[h1++];
                if (v2[x][y] >= 0) continue;
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    x1 = x + dir[i][0];
                    y1 = y + dir[i][1];
                    if (inside(x1, y1) && v1[x1][y1] < 0) {
                        v1[x1][y1] = v1[x][y] + 1;
                        if (v1[x1][y1] > T) break;
                        if (v2[x1][y1] >= 0) continue;
                        q1[t1++] = x1; q1[t1++] = y1;

                        if (s2[x1][y1] != '0') {
                            add(id[sx][sy], id[x1][y1] + cnt, 10);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            up1 = t1;

            while (h2 < up2) {
                x = q2[h2++]; y = q2[h2++];
                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    x1 = x + dir[i][0];
                    y1 = y + dir[i][1];
                    if (inside(x1, y1) && v2[x1][y1] < 0) {
                        v2[x1][y1] = v2[x][y] + 1;
                        q2[t2++] = x1; q2[t2++] = y1;
                    }
                }
            }
            up2 = t2;
        }
    }

    static boolean bfsFlow() {
        Arrays.fill(vis, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        vis[s] = 1;
        q.add(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int i = h[u]; i != -1; i = nxt[i]) {
                if (cap[i] > 0 && vis[vv[i]] == 0) {
                    int v = vv[i];
                    pre[v] = i;
                    if (v == t) return true;
                    vis[v] = 1;
                    q.add(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static int maxFlow() {
        int ans = 0;
        while (bfsFlow()) {
            int mi = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            int v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                v = pre[v];
                if (cap[v] < mi) mi = cap[v];
                v = vv[v ^ 1];
            }
            ans += mi;
            v = t;
            while (v != s) {
                v = pre[v];
                cap[v] -= mi;
                cap[v ^ 1] += mi;
                v = vv[v ^ 1];
            }
        }
        return ans;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        T = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            s1[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            s2[i] = sc.nextLine().toCharArray();
        }
        Arrays.fill(h, -1);
        e = 0;
        cnt = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                id[i][j] = -1;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (s1[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    xz = i; yz = j;
                } else if (inside(i, j)) {
                    id[i][j] = ++cnt;
                }
            }
        }
        s = 0;
        t = 2 * cnt + 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (inside(i, j)) {
                    bfs(i, j);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(maxFlow());
    }
}
